previous.changeLog: Correct research XP cost on convergent tech-tree nodes. Vehicle unlocks are now priced from the game's own tech-tree data (cheapest-available parent, with any blueprint discount already applied) instead of the currently-selected vehicle's edge. On a vehicle reachable from more than one parent with different costs the bar's confirmation dialog previously showed a higher XP cost than the native research button and could have overcharged the unlock. Both now match the game exactly.

current.changeLog: Richer buff tooltips. Field-modification and skill-tree buff lines now render like the game's own perk tooltip: the parameter icon, the change value colored green for a buff / red for a nerf (orange in color-blind mode), and the stat it affects — e.g. +50 HP to vehicle hit points, -0.10 s to aiming time. Absolute values now show their unit; the buff/nerf color follows the game's own classification, so a beneficial reduction still reads as green. Fix: sub-unit buff numbers are no longer dropped from upgrade tooltips. A small add KPI on a dispersion-scale hundredth (e.g. gun dispersion -0.01) used to lose its figure, so the tooltip showed only the qualitative sentence with no magnitude. The number now survives while a genuine ~zero still collapses.
